description: Expected results for the official Elmer/Ice test elmerice/Tests/Friction_Weertman (ISMIP-HOM B020 set-up: 2D full-Stokes ice flow down a 0.5 degree slope over a sine bed, L = 20 km, Weertman sliding with beta = 0.02, n = 3). inputs/ are the unmodified files from the ElmerCSC/elmerfem git tree (commit 0a0fcfe). Steady run: ElmerGrid 1 2 rectangle.grd, then ElmerSolver ismip_weertman.sif. Units in the .sif are m, years and MPa.

numeric_checks.name: all_done_line
numeric_checks.why: ElmerSolver prints its own success line '*** Elmer Solver: ALL DONE ***'

numeric_checks.name: reference_compare_passed
numeric_checks.why: OFFICIAL: ElmerSolver's own CompareToReferenceSolution prints 'PASSED all 1 tests' and writes TEST.PASSED = 1 (the official ctest pass rule)

numeric_checks.name: ns_final_norm
numeric_checks.why: OFFICIAL: 'Solver 3 :: Reference Norm = Real 56.70374' in ismip_weertman.sif; tol = Elmer's default Reference Norm Tolerance 1e-5 relative (ElmerSolver.F90)

numeric_checks.name: ns_nonlinear_iterations
numeric_checks.why: Stokes nonlinear iterations to reach 1e-5 (own run)

numeric_checks.name: n_nodes
numeric_checks.why: 41 x 11 nodes from rectangle.grd (40 x 10 elements)

numeric_checks.name: n_cells
numeric_checks.why: 400 quads + 100 boundary line elements in the VTU

numeric_checks.name: n_surface_nodes
numeric_checks.why: nodes on the mapped top surface z = -x tan(0.5 deg)

numeric_checks.name: n_bed_nodes
numeric_checks.why: nodes on the mapped sine bed

numeric_checks.name: max_speed
numeric_checks.why: largest ice speed in the domain, m/a (own run; tol = 1e-6 relative)

numeric_checks.name: mean_surface_vx
numeric_checks.why: mean along-flow surface velocity, m/a (own run; tol = 1e-6 relative)

numeric_checks.name: max_surface_vx
numeric_checks.why: largest along-flow surface velocity, m/a (own run; tol = 1e-6 relative)

numeric_checks.name: mean_bed_speed
numeric_checks.why: mean sliding speed on the bed (Weertman law), m/a (own run; tol = 1e-6 relative)

numeric_checks.name: max_pressure
numeric_checks.why: largest pressure, MPa (about rho g H at the thickest ice) (own run; tol = 1e-6 relative)

numeric_checks.name: mean_pressure
numeric_checks.why: mean pressure over all nodes, MPa (own run; tol = 1e-6 relative)

recorded_with: /home/server/knowledge-dissection-toolkit/auto_dissect/_work/Elmer_Ice/install_ice/bin/ElmerSolver (+ ElmerGrid from the same dir), serial, OMP_NUM_THREADS=4, run through tools/run_elmerice.py
reference: Official reference: the Reference Norm 56.70374 written in the official .sif by the test authors (L. Tavard, LGGE, 26.11.2015, rev 522ee2e). This run gave Norm = 56.7037392, relative error 1.38e-8.
notes: The OFFICIAL checks are reference_compare_passed and ns_final_norm. The other numbers were recorded from our own run; two clean runs gave the same values to all printed digits (9 significant digits), so the run repeats. VTU fields are read straight from the file because tools/parse_vtu_output.py cannot read Elmer's default binary (appended raw) VTU.
